name: kidan
description: Privacy-first Orthodox Christian introductions on Telegram

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kidan/contracts && npm run dev -w @kidan/miniapp
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @kidan/contracts && npm run dev -w @kidan/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kidan/contracts && npm run build -w @kidan/miniapp && npm run build -w @kidan/api && npm run build -w @kidan/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kidan/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @kidan/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @kidan/miniapp && npm run typecheck -w @kidan/api && npm run typecheck -w @kidan/bot
scripts.test: npm run build -w @kidan/contracts && npm run test -w @kidan/contracts && npm run test -w @kidan/miniapp && npm run test -w @kidan/api && npm run test -w @kidan/bot
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
